blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres expressed admiration for Ifugao’s centuries-old rice terraces and local traditions during a two-day visit to the province following the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila.
